newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 9.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) calls on Cambodia's co-premiers to peacefully settle dispute.
-- Government advisory panel recommends cuts in municipal subsidies.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd stepped up compensation for losses by corporate racketeers under former president Hideo Sakamaki.
